2.88.51
Chart.ThreeDProperties
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Chart.ThreeDProperties element specifies the properties for a 3D chart layout. This element is
optional. This element is of type ThreeDProperties.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ThreeDProperties element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ThreeDProperties element.
 <xsd:element name="ThreeDProperties" type="ThreeDPropertiesType" minOccurs="0" />
